projects.pageSubtitle: A showcase of technical excellence across Australia's most demanding environments.

p1.title: Pilbara Rail Expansion
p1.description: Geotechnical investigation for 400km of new heavy-haul rail alignment.
p1.outcome: Delivered 3 weeks ahead of schedule, enabling early track laying.

p2.title: Perth CBD High-Rise
p2.description: Foundation pile testing and vibration monitoring for a 50-storey tower.
p2.outcome: Verified pile integrity to AS 2159 standards with zero defects.

p3.title: Offshore Platform NDT
p3.description: Comprehensive non-destructive testing of platform jacket legs using phased array ultrasonics.
p3.outcome: Identified critical fatigue cracking, allowing for preventative maintenance.

p4.title: Highway Bridge Upgrade
p4.description: GPR scanning and concrete strength assessment for aging bridge assets.
p4.outcome: Mapped all reinforcement, ensuring safe drilling for widening works.

p5.title: Moomba SA Cementing for Santos
p5.description: Comprehensive cementing quality assurance and non-destructive testing services for Santos oil and gas operations at Moomba.
p5.outcome: Ensured cementing integrity across multiple wells, meeting stringent Santos specifications and industry standards.

p6.title: Olympic Dam Mining Project
p6.description: Large-scale geotechnical investigations and structural testing for underground mine expansion at Olympic Dam copper-uranium mine.
p6.outcome: Delivered critical foundation analysis supporting safe mine expansion, completed ahead of schedule with zero safety incidents.

p7.title: Melbourne Metro Tunnel Expansion
p7.description: Major upgrade works supporting the city's core transport network with comprehensive structural testing and monitoring.
p7.outcome: Successfully delivered critical testing services ensuring tunnel integrity and passenger safety for Melbourne's expanding metro system.

p8.title: West Gate Bridge Strengthening
p8.description: Reinforcement and structural reliability improvements for Melbourne's iconic bridge with advanced NDT and assessment.
p8.outcome: Comprehensive structural analysis enabled targeted strengthening works, extending bridge service life by 25 years.

p9.title: Western Suburbs Pipeline Upgrade
p9.description: Critical pipeline enhancements improving supply reliability in the western corridor with integrity testing and monitoring.
p9.outcome: Delivered comprehensive pipeline integrity assessment ensuring safe, reliable energy supply to growing western communities.

p10.title: Port of Melbourne Wharf Refurbishment
p10.description: Structural remediation and modernisation of port-side assets with marine concrete testing and corrosion assessment.
p10.outcome: Identified critical structural defects and guided remediation works, ensuring continued safe port operations and cargo handling.

services.pageSubtitle: Comprehensive testing, inspection, and engineering solutions for mission-critical projects.

oilandgas.title: Oil & Gas Engineering Services
oilandgas.short: High-end engineering support and integrity services for the upstream and midstream sectors.
oilandgas.full: MBSC Australia provides specialised engineering and integrity solutions for drilling, reservoir, and production operations. This includes cementing QA/QC, well integrity diagnostics, structural assessment, corrosion evaluation, and production optimisation support.

geotech.title: Geotechnical Investigations
geotech.short: Comprehensive ground analysis for civil and mining infrastructure.
geotech.full: MBSC Australia provides rigorous geotechnical site investigations to ensure foundational integrity. Our services include borehole drilling, soil sampling, laboratory testing, and detailed reporting compliant with AS 1726 standards.

concreteNdt.title: Concrete NDT & Precast QC
concreteNdt.short: Non-destructive testing and rigorous quality control for concrete structures and precast manufacturing.
concreteNdt.full: Utilising advanced Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity (UPV) and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), we assess concrete integrity without structural damage. We detect voids, rebar corrosion, and delamination in critical infrastructure. We ensure precast elements meet stringent project specifications (AS 3850). From pre-pour inspections to post-cure strength testing, our QC protocols mitigate risk in large-scale construction.

geophysics.title: Engineering Geophysics
geophysics.short: Subsurface mapping using state-of-the-art sensing technology.
geophysics.full: Our geophysical surveys provide non-invasive mapping of subsurface conditions. Essential for cavity detection, bedrock profiling, and utility mapping in complex industrial environments.

mining.title: Mining Services
mining.short: Specialised testing and inspection for the resources sector.
mining.full: Supporting the lifecycle of mine sites from exploration to rehabilitation. We offer tailings dam monitoring, shaft integrity testing, and heavy-machinery foundation analysis.

civil.title: Civil Infrastructure
civil.short: End-to-end engineering support for public and private works.
civil.full: Partnering with government and private contractors to deliver safe, compliant infrastructure. Bridges, tunnels, roads, and marine structures benefit from our lifecycle testing services.
